name: Azure Blob Storage
shortInfo: Azure Blob storage provides scalable, cost-efficient object storage in the cloud.
brief: The Azure Blob Storage Reverse ETL connector enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to the Azure Blob Storage platform in an automated manner.
about:
Azure Blob Storage stores text and binary data as objects in the cloud. Blob Storage offers the following resources: the storage account, containers, and blobs. Within your storage account, containers provide a way to organize sets of blobs.

Check more about Azure Blob Storage api doc [here](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/operations-on-blobs).
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/azure-blob-storage/syncs/export.html)

This sync enables moving data from a user specified datawarehouse to the Azure Blob Storage.
